MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Monthly: (1) ingest broker claims bordereaux CSVs (each broker has its own column conventions - 14 broker-specific source definitions maintained by hand); (2) compute ceded claims per quota-share treaties; (3) produce Lloyd's-format outward bordereau. Policy ref arrives as 'AL/MOT/9999999' and must be re-keyed to 'ALB-MOT-9999999' (EXP_REKEY_POLICY). Amounts arrive as text with pound-sign and thousands commas.
MAPPING.NAME: m_RI_BORDEREAUX_MONTHLY

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Re-key broker policy reference format to POLARIS format.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_REKEY_POLICY

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Currency text to decimal: strips pound sign and commas.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_AMT_CLEAN

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Albion product -> Solvency II LoB mapping. DRIFTED from the SAS copy (08_solvency_ii_qrt_prep.sas): PET maps to 'Other motor' here since a 2023 fat-finger edit; SAS maps PET to 'Miscellaneous financial loss'. QRT and outward bordereau therefore report PET under different LoBs.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_SII_LOB

WORKFLOW.DESCRIPTION: Monthly WD3 after all broker BDX files arrive (file watcher per broker; BRK0007 habitually 2 days late - manual restart runbook in Confluence, page last edited 2022).
WORKFLOW.NAME: wf_REINSURANCE_BORDEREAUX_MONTHLY
